title: Never Fall
style: Eurodance with gritty rhythmic male rap and big anthemic female vocal, hard-gated kick and bass, driving 140 BPM four-on-the-floor pulse, bright synth leads, piano breakdown, rising snare builds, layered chorus harmonies and a 90s dance-pop mix
lyrics:
[Genre: Eurodance, Anthemic, 90s Dance-Pop]
[Tempo: 140 BPM]
[Mood: Defiant, Triumphant, Rebellious]

[Intro - Spoken, dry, deadpan, filtered beat]
Break the wall...
Break it all...
We rise free — never fall.
No divide...
No control...
This is fire in our soul.

[Verse 1 - Male Rap, gritty, rhythmic]
Clock in, clock out, another day, another line
They draw the borders in your head, tell you where to stand in time
Feed the machine, keep your head down, keep the wheels alive
But every gear they bolt in me, I break it — I survive
They want us split, color, corner, keep the fences high
But we don't bleed by their design, we don't live by their lie

[Build - Rising energy, half-sung, snare roll]
Can you feel it — rising, rising
No more hiding — no compromising
Here it comes — here it comes —

[Drop]

[Chorus - Female Vocal, big anthemic hook, full production]
Break the wall!
Break it all!
We rise free — never fall!
No divide!
No control!
This is fire in our soul!
(Never fall — never fall — we won't break, we won't crawl!)
Never fall!

[Verse 2 - Male Rap, same energy as Verse 1]
They point the finger, pick a side, tell you who to blame
Turn your neighbor to a stranger, turn a face into a name
Every headline sharper, every feed another fight
They don't want us talking — just divided, day and night
Us and them, and them and us, that's the only game they play
But the wall's not made of people, it's the ones who profit either way

[Build - Shorter, more urgent]
Rising, rising —
No compromising —
Here it comes —

[Drop]

[Chorus - Female Vocal, repeat]
Break the wall!
Break it all!
We rise free — never fall!
No divide!
No control!
This is fire in our soul!
(Never fall — never fall — we won't break, we won't crawl!)
Never fall!

[Breakdown - Stripped back, piano or vocal-only, half-time]
Maybe we forgot — we were never meant to kneel
Maybe every wall they built was never even real
So take my hand, not my label
We're the ones still standing —
Still standing —

[Final Buildup - Riser, snare roll, fast energy climb]
Here it comes — here it comes — HERE IT COMES —

[Final Chorus - Full intensity, key change, layered harmonies]
Break the wall!
Break it all!
We rise free — never fall!
No divide!
No control!
This is fire in our soul!
Never fall — never fall — we won't break, we won't crawl!
Never fall!

[Outro - Instrumental hook fading, faint spoken callback]
Never fall...
